title: What It Actually Looks Like to Want Something Badly and Still Say No
caption:
Wanting isn't the sin. Being run by it is. Unnamed desire operates from the dark, which is exactly why saying it out loud to one brother strips half its power before you even decide anything.

Most of what you're craving right now, you'd survive without. Ask what actually happens if you don't get it. Usually: nothing. And every want you don't chase builds the same muscle you'll need for the next one. Discipline isn't a personality trait. It's reps.

A man ruled by his wants has just traded one master for another and called it freedom. Christ in you says no on your behalf when you can't say it yourself.

#faith #discipline #selfcontrol #godlyman #christianmen
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
